query:
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM meta_messaging_conversation WHERE connection_id=$1 AND kind='direct'
                AND ((customer_phone=$2 AND customer_id<>$2) OR (customer_id=$2 AND customer_phone IS DISTINCT FROM $2)))
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM meta_messaging_group_participant p JOIN meta_messaging_conversation c ON c.channel_id=p.channel_id WHERE c.connection_id=$1 AND c.kind='group' AND p.phone=$2 AND p.customer_id<>$2) AS "ambiguous!"
